title: Implement article root node builder and canonical CID computation
description: Assemble the root node from header_cid, body_cid, mime_cid (Option<Cid>), and metadata. Encode as DAG-CBOR. Compute the root CID (CIDv1 SHA-256 DAG-CBOR codec). This CID is the canonical article CID used in the group log and Message-ID->CID map. This issue updates the scope of stoa-a2023a88.2.3 (Implement CID computation) to implement this root node builder.
notes: Size: S. Depends on Issue D (header block builder), Issue E (body block builder), Issue F (MIME parser, for mime_cid), and Issue G (metadata computation).
